description: Modernization Score v1.3. Weights and bands taken from the BRD 'Modernization Scoring Tool' and verified against the Power BI dashboard (EAI 10969 = 79.61, EAI 14381 = 79.67). Rulesets are immutable: any change publishes a new version.

metrics.name: Kenna Score
metrics.note: Host security risk, derived from Qualys vulnerability scans. BRD 'ALL Sections': a 0 is excluded like a null (ADR 0019).

metrics.name: DR In-Scope
metrics.note: v1.3 dashboard, 'DR Inscope Value': if Critical Application Indicator = N then null, else Yes = 100, No = 20, anything else null. Confirmed by the report owner on 2026-10-07. An unknown indicator does not exclude, as in the report.

metrics.name: SCA Flaws (Critical)
metrics.note: RFC-05: by default the presence of at least one open flaw is evaluated, not the count.

metrics.name: SCA Flaws (Medium)
metrics.note: BRD: 'Medium (removed from score)'. Weight 0, kept for display.

metrics.name: SCA Flaws (Low)
metrics.note: BRD: 'Low (removed from score)'. Weight 0, kept for display.

metrics.name: MFA
metrics.note: Missing MFA is only penalized when the application has users.

metrics.name: Open-Source Score

mapping.identityLabel: raw value × weight, as the v1.3 report does

metrics.note: Raw value × 10% since 2026-10-07 (ADR 0032): the v1.3 report uses the OSS Score as it comes (37 → 3.70). The BRD worked example mapped it by bands (0-59 → 20, 60-74 → 60, 75-100 → 100). BRD 'ALL Sections': a 0 is excluded like a null (ADR 0019). Rows with EAI Code 0 in the real file are not applications and match nothing.

metrics.name: RAW Tech Score

mapping.identityLabel: raw value × weight, as the v1.3 report does

metrics.note: Raw value × 5% since 2026-10-07 (ADR 0032): the v1.3 report uses the Raw_Tech_Score as it comes (88.48 → 4.42). The BRD worked example mapped it by bands (0-59 → 20, 60-74 → 60, 75-100 → 100). Calculated at component level from each component's end-of-life date. BRD 'ALL Sections': a 0 is excluded like a null (ADR 0019).

metrics.name: Architectural Value
metrics.note: RFC-01: if CMT delivers the composite already calculated, that value wins over the counts.

metrics.name: Tech Debt Score
metrics.note: RFC-03: the BRD weights table states 5 and the v1.3 dashboard states 10; 10 is used because it is the published dashboard weight. Neither golden case (14381, 10969) has Tech Debt data, so the choice is not numerically verified. zeroIsNoData stays false: the BRD table scores 0 as its own data point (0 -> 100), and the specific rule wins over 'ALL Sections'.

metrics.name: Automation DevSecOps Score
metrics.note: BRD: 'Removed from calculation'. Weight 0. The BRD table maps '0/NULL-3' to 20, so a null would score 20 if the metric ever regains weight; today a null is excluded like any other metric (RFC-14).

metrics.name: Containerized
metrics.note: BRD: weight 4 struck through in the weights table. 'No' does not score (NULL). The BRD also says 'This score is added to product strategy (2 pts) and architecture value (2 pts)'; the v1.3 dashboard shows both composites at 10, which the BRD worked example for EAI 14381 confirms (denominator 25 = RAW 5 + ArchValue 10 + ProductStrategy 10). See RFC-01.

metrics.name: Application Disposition / Roadmap
metrics.note: BRD: 'Currently removed from calculation'. Weight 0, but mapped: it feeds the future plan section. 'Consolidate' is not in the BRD disposition score table; it comes from the MAPS model (roadmap-v1.json) and its 20 is an assumption (RFC-15).

metrics.name: Monitoring
metrics.note: A single enabled capability (Elastic Agent, Synthetics or APM) is enough to score 100.

metrics.name: Operational Score

source.report: EAI/CMT export, Operational_Score (ServiceNow incident & problem, 12-month window)

metrics.note: BRD 'ALL Sections': a 0 is excluded like a null (ADR 0019).
